subject.title: fix(ios): keep While Using selected after approval

question: Should this PR wait for exact-head iOS permission prompt proof and stale-diff cleanup before merge, or should maintainers explicitly override the proof gap?
rationale: The code fix is plausible, but ClawSweeper cannot treat build-for-testing and unexecuted UI tests as real behavior proof for an external PR that changes an iOS permission flow.

options.title: Require proof and cleanup
options.body: Wait for redacted exact-head simulator or device prompt proof, remove the release-owned changelog edit, and rebase away already-merged gateway/outbound diffs before merge.

options.title: Override the proof gap
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the build/test evidence without live prompt execution if they are comfortable owning that merge risk.

options.title: Ask for a narrow replacement
options.body: If the stale branch remains noisy, ask for an iOS-only branch that preserves the useful waiter fix and tests.

recommendation.title: Require proof and cleanup
recommendation.body: Wait for redacted exact-head simulator or device prompt proof, remove the release-owned changelog edit, and rebase away already-merged gateway/outbound diffs before merge.
